My agency had 11 people in 2023. It has 3 now, and we make more money.

Here's what changed: I stopped selling hours.

We used to bill $150 an hour and argue about timesheets. Now we sell one thing, a 6-week launch package, at $18,000, and we don't discuss hours at all.

The clients who left were the ones who wanted to buy time.

The clients who stayed wanted a result, and they didn't care how long it took us.

Two of the people I let go started their own shops. One of them is now our subcontractor at $200 an hour. She's happy. I'm happy. The maths is weird but it works.
